rationale: The short thesis hinged on price staying below VWAP ($42.44) and the 5m 9-EMA ($42.07), but the last three 1-minute candles are consecutively higher and the latest close ($42.10) has reclaimed the 9-EMA, breaking a core condition of the entry.
